summary: Ordered success-check scan in test_walkthrough_has_ordered_success_checks_for_every_evaluation_stage requires all 10 named stages (quickstart, client-auth, submission, container launch, attach/detach, plan-artifact, approval, PR, completion, teardown) each with observable-outcome keywords (queued/live/401/ITERATING/diff/merged/gone/COMPLETE); mutation-dropping any single Success check marker fails the test.
